dialogues.speaker: Chaonan
dialogues.text: The problem is my personality... That, and luck not being on my side.

dialogues.speaker: Chaonan
dialogues.text: *sigh* It's funny, you know, the day before I signed up I even made a point of going out and buying this feather, which is supposed to bring good luck. Clearly, it had no effect whatsoever...

dialogues.speaker: Chaonan
dialogues.text: ...Well, no use complaining about it. Here, you can have it, maybe it works better on adventurers.
